description: This Java class defines an immutable data object representing a subset of loan transaction data related to repayment periods within the Fineract project. It holds details such as transaction ID, loan ID, date, reversal status, amounts involved, and fee charges.

classes.description: Immutable data object representing a subset of loan transaction data.
